sections.title: Building and supporting an opinion: meaning and form
body: Goal: Give a clear opinion, support it with reasons and examples, and acknowledge another perspective.
Core vocabulary: ett argument, en fördel, en nackdel. Key phrases: Jag anser att kollektivtrafik är viktig. · En fördel är att fler kan resa billigt. · Å andra sidan måste turerna vara pålitliga.

Build an answer in layers: viewpoint, reason, example and conclusion. Use Jag anser att or Jag tycker att for the viewpoint; eftersom or för det första for reasons; till exempel for evidence; and därför or sammanfattningsvis for the conclusion. Use å ena sidan … å andra sidan … for balance.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

examples.en: I believe public transport is important.

examples.en: One advantage is that more people can travel cheaply.

examples.fi: Å andra sidan måste turerna vara pålitliga.
examples.en: On the other hand, services must be reliable.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Enligt min åsikt är fördelarna större.” is a formal-neutral opinion way to express “In my view, the benefits are greater.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What solution does the speaker prefer? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Why does the writer support longer opening hours? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Give a one-minute opinion on free public activities. State your view, give two reasons, include an example and acknowledge one limitation. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write 110–130 words responding to a proposal for longer library hours. Organise your view, support and conclusion clearly. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: You must now argue the opposite position; keep a respectful tone and use different supporting reasons.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
